subtasks: Complete the equation by selecting the correct missing number or operator and placing it on the pad, then reset the robot arm.

Use the right gripper to pick up the black disk with the white multiplication sign ×, third disk from the left in the front row of four operators. Place it flat, upright and centered on the empty pad between 3 and 2 to make 3 × 2 = 6. Open and return both arms home.
Set the multiplication disk flat on the clear table directly below the right gripper for transfer to the left gripper. Open the right gripper, lift it away, and return the right arm home.

Use the left gripper to pick up the multiplication disk × immediately left of the loose red 3 in the middle of the table. Center the disk on the empty tan pad between the blue 3 and the orange 2 in the back row. Keep × flat and upright, open both grippers and return both arms home.
Return both robot arms to their initial home poses with both grippers fully open. The equation is complete. Retract clear of the equation.
